## Objective
Find the current Node.js LTS (Long Term Support) version as of August 2026, its LTS promotion date, and EOL date. Return the exact version number, dates, and sources.

## Context
The year is 2026. Node.js follows a predictable release schedule (new even-numbered major versions every April, promoted to LTS every October). We need the currently active LTS line(s) as of August 5, 2026 and when the current LTS was promoted. Use official sources: nodejs.org release page, GitHub nodejs/Release repository, and the nodejs.org download page as cross-references.

## Output contract
Return results in standard deep-researcher-v2 format with these sections:
- ### CLAIM LEDGER (each claim with source URLs and confidence)
- ### SYNTHESIS (exact version number, LTS promotion date, EOL date, in plain text)
- ### SOURCES (numbered list of URLs fetched)

Do not include any commentary or analysis outside these sections. Return the answer verbatim.

## Boundaries
- Only research Node.js LTS versions — do not research other runtimes or frameworks
- Only use official or authoritative sources (nodejs.org, GitHub nodejs org, etc.)
- Do not include speculative future versions — only versions that are already released and active LTS as of August 2026
